description: This file defines the 'Unique' class representing a UNIQUE constraint in Spark's SQL connector catalog. It includes methods for constraint properties, equality, and building instances.

classes.name: Unique
classes.description: Represents a UNIQUE constraint with columns, validation status, and enforcement details.

classes.name: Unique.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing Unique constraint instances.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns the columns that comprise the unique key.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the constraint definition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Unique object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code for the Unique object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a Unique constraint instance.
